Intro call - Ellis Plumbing
Date: 14 October 2026
Attendees: Liam Duff (Time to Revenue), Jordan Ellis (Ellis Plumbing)

Liam Duff: Thanks for making time, Jordan. How's the week going?
Jordan Ellis: Busy. Two vans out on emergency jobs since six this morning.
Liam Duff: Good busy, I hope. You said on the form that calls were the problem.
Jordan Ellis: Yeah. When we're all on jobs, nobody picks up the phone.
Jordan Ellis: Priya checks voicemail at the end of the day, but by then people have called someone else.
Liam Duff: Roughly how many calls do you think you miss in a week?
Jordan Ellis: Honestly I don't know. Could be ten, could be thirty. We don't track it.
Liam Duff: That's normal. Most trades businesses I talk to don't track it either.
Liam Duff: What happens to a missed call right now?
Jordan Ellis: If they leave a message, Priya calls back the next morning.
Jordan Ellis: If they don't leave a message, it's just gone.
Liam Duff: So the first thing would be to measure it before we change anything.
Jordan Ellis: Makes sense. I hate paying for stuff when I can't see if it works.
Liam Duff: Fair. Our call tracker sits in front of your existing number and logs every missed call.
Liam Duff: It texts the caller back within a minute so they don't move on.
Jordan Ellis: The text-back part is what I like. People here text more than they call anyway.
Jordan Ellis: My worry is it sounding like a robot. Our customers know us.
Liam Duff: You write the message yourself, so it sounds like you.
Jordan Ellis: Okay. What does it cost?
Liam Duff: We'd start with a free two-week trial so you can see the missed-call numbers first.
Jordan Ellis: Free I can do. I'd want Priya to see the reports too.
Liam Duff: No problem, she can have her own login.
Liam Duff: I'll send the setup link and a draft text message by Friday.
Jordan Ellis: Great. I'll get our phone provider details to you before then.
Liam Duff: If the numbers look bad after two weeks, we'll talk about the paid plan.
Jordan Ellis: And if they look fine, I'll have learned something for free.
Liam Duff: Exactly. Anything else on your mind?
Jordan Ellis: My brother-in-law runs an electrical business. He has the same problem.
Jordan Ellis: I'll mention you to him if this works.
Liam Duff: I'd appreciate that. Talk Friday.
Jordan Ellis: Cheers, Liam.
